entities.summary: William Albert Wack, CSC is an American Catholic prelate who has served as Bishop of Pensacola–Tallahassee since 2017. He is a member of the Congregation of Holy Cross. William Wack was a performers & entertainers from South Bend (b. 1967-06-28, South Bend). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
